theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months expenses. Start small, grow consistently. It's your financial cushion.
caption: Having emergency savings helps you handle unexpected situations without derailing goals. It provides peace of mind and financial stability. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #SavingsGoals #FinancialWellness #SmartMoney
